cases.prompt: Use this procedure for a bounded real task: Build a disposable logic or interface prototype around one explicit uncertainty, with observable state, representative scenarios, and a removal decision. Use when cheap interaction evidence is more useful than further abstract discussion.
sourceAnchors: A prototype answers one named question; it is evidence, not production code. Define its audience, decision, success signal, time budget, disposal path, and forbidden dependencies before building.
